args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady (Juniper blog, 2026).
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, tying surcharge costs more closely to fuel market movements.
• Per the companion piece, shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least overall.
args.title: Freight Pricing Summary — Juniper Blog & Companion Piece
